- Remove the brake/clutch fluid reservoir cap and connect suitable equipment to the reservoir.

- Remove the protective plug and connect the bleed recovery device (pipe and reservoir) to the clutch hydraulic actuator.

- Open the bleed valve on the clutch hydraulic actuator.

- Open the fluid reservoir tap slowly.

- Wait for all the air in the clutch release hydraulic system to escape completely.

- Close the bleed valve on the clutch slave cylinder and refit the protective cap in its seat.

- Remove the bleed equipment.

- Check that the cluch disengages and that the gears engage properly.

- Check the fluid level in the brake-clutch reservoir is correct.
